text:
sarah.m: Heads-up — escalated customer (AcmeCorp) is hitting intermittent function-call validation failures when using our tool-calling flow. They get a 422 with "invalid_schema" and a truncated response body. Request ID they sent: rq_3b7f9a2b. They tried a curl repro but it doesn't include the x-request-id header or full response. Can someone help gather logs and a debug bundle?

alex.g: Thanks. Do we have the exact timestamp window and the raw curl they used? Also which model+variant? That helps narrow kernel/quant.

sarah.m: Timestamp window: ~2024-05-05T14:12:20Z to 14:13:05Z. They said model=rwd-llama-13b-quant-v2 but pinned to autoscaled pool. Here is the sanitized curl they pasted (redacted API key):

sarah.m: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-13b-quant-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize order","metadata":{} }],"functions":[{"name":"get_order","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}}}}},"call":{"name":"get_order"}}]}'
```

sarah.m: They also included this error snippet from client: "{"error":{"type":"invalid_schema","message":"expected array for items, got null"}}" — but their schema clearly marks items as array.

infra-bot: Log lookup completed for rq_3b7f9a2b: 
- backend: inference-runtime-03
- status: 422
- model: rwd-llama-13b-quant-v2
- node: gpu-pool-2a
- error: functioncall_schema_validation_failed
- error_detail: path=/functions/0/parameters/properties/items/type expected array but got null
- trace_id: tr_e9c1b4

alex.g: That error_detail suggests the customer passed items: null somewhere in the request. Could be upstream sanitizer or a bug in our structured output post-processing that coerces missing arrays to null when kv cache is used.

priya.k: Two quick asks to collect from customer for reproducibility: 1) full raw request body (including headers) and 2) a curl with --include and --trace-ascii to capture response headers/body. Also ask them to run the repro with a short prompt so we can iterate quickly.

mike.r: From an engineering POV, we should also request a debug bundle created with the CLI which captures node logs + env: `redwood-cli support bundle create --request rq_3b7f9a2b --include-kvcache --output acmecorp-rq_3b7f9a2b.zip`. That bundle will include the fenced runtime logs where the schema validation happens.

alex.g: Agreed. Sarah, can you ask them to run that CLI or we can create the bundle server-side if they prefer? If they can't run CLI, we need permission to grab a bundle (legal ok?).

sarah.m: Asking now. Also requested the full raw POST body and asked them to re-run with `--trace-ascii` and `-i` flags.

sarah.m: Customer reply: "We can't install the CLI in prod, but we can re-run the single failing request in a staging copy and send the curl output. We'll attach the raw JSON and the response headers." They attached a short raw JSON (sanitized):

sarah.m: ```json
{"model":"rwd-llama-13b-quant-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Get order 123"}],"functions":[{"name":"get_order","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}}},"required":["order_id"]}},"call":{"name":"get_order"}}]}
```

sarah.m: And their staging curl trace shows the request body as above and response headers: `HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity`, `x-request-id: rq_3b7f9a2b`, `x-runtime-node: inference-runtime-03`. Response body: `{"error":{"type":"invalid_schema","message":"expected array for items, got null"}}`.

priya.k: Interesting — the request body doesn't include items at all (items omitted) but validation complains about null. That points to our validator treating missing properties as null when function call path merges defaults or when kv cache injection occurs. We should check the pre-validation merge hook.

mike.r: I'll spin up a local repro: call our runtime with the same body and kvcache enabled. If I can reproduce, I'll capture the stack and open an ENG ticket. Can someone drop the exact headers the customer used (content-type etc.)?

sarah.m: They used `Content-Type: application/json` and `Accept: application/json`. No special flags.

alex.g: Good. Mike, if you reproduce, please attach the runtime log lines around schema validation (look for "functioncall_schema_validation_failed") and paste the minimal failing request that reproduces the shift from omitted -> null. Also include whether the KV cache was present in that run; ask infra-bot to surface recent KV cache writes for that trace_id.

infra-bot: KV cache entries for trace tr_e9c1b4: found 2 writes at +12ms and +48ms; keys: kv_user_prefix:acme:order:123. No obvious null injections, but I'll attach the raw kv blobs to the support ticket.

sarah.m: Customer agreed to run the CLI in staging and will upload the bundle to our secure support S3. I've created support ticket SUP-4321 and linked the uploaded bundle when available.

alex.g: Next steps: Mike to attempt local repro, Priya to write quick triage doc with hypothesis (missing arrays -> null via pre-validator merge), and Sarah to monitor customer bundle upload. If confirmed, we should add a regression test in the function-calling suite for omitted array vs null.

mike.r: I'll aim to have a repro + initial root-cause by EOD. Sharing :eyes:.

priya.k: I'll draft the triage note and include a small curl snippet for the customer to test variations:

priya.k: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/run \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-13b-quant-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Get order 123"}],"functions":[{"name":"get_order","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"}}}}},"required":["order_id"]},"call":{"name":"get_order"}}]}' --trace-ascii trace.txt
```

sarah.m: Perfect. I'll paste updates here when bundle arrives. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Note: Created internal support artifact SUP-4321 and attached trace_id tr_e9c1b4 for ENG review.
